scenes.problem: Calculate 0.4 × 0.3. Show each partial product and check the decimal point.
rows: Rewrite 0.4 as 4 ÷ 10^1; the decimal point sets the first scale.
Rewrite 0.3 as 3 ÷ 10^1; both scales combine to 10^2.
Multiply 4 × 3 × 10^0 = 12; align this partial product in its place-value column.
Add the aligned partial products: 12 = 12.
Divide 12 by 10^2; place the decimal point 2 digits from the right: 0.12.
scenes.memo: 0.12 ÷ 0.3 = 0.4, so the product agrees with both original decimal factors.
scenes.misconception: Keep each partial product aligned; count BOTH original decimal places before replacing the point.
